# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia and HarfBuzz updates** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expanded named script coverage. The cumulative line includes GPU rendering corrections and a stronger per-process hash seed. Preview 1 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0; Preview 2 introduces HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and 30 additional Script constants. Later collected work remains separate from those exact shipment summaries.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158 engine** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. The initial cut uses HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.300 with native HarfBuzz 14.4.0; the subsequent HarfBuzz update adopts native 15.0.0. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634), [#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554), [#5702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5702))

## API Surface

- **Complete named HarfBuzz scripts** — HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 documented Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, plus 27 previously omitted constants. Existing fields, numeric values, parsing, conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact; Script stays a struct rather than becoming an enum. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct reflected hairlines and text-atlas selection** — Zero-length square-capped hairlines retain the correct scale under reflected transforms, with non-finite outsets suppressed. Ganesh rounds ordinary and LCD text-atlas indices before selecting a sampler to avoid interpolation errors choosing the wrong atlas. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Bound Graphite clip recording** — Render-pass capacity checks account for clips still needing recording. A draw whose full effective clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass is rejected and logged rather than overflowing pass structures. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Vulkan cleanup and displacement precision** — Affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but excluding, 56 get a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay. Native synchronous submission propagates fence-wait failure, but GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offsets use float precision to match filter bounds. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **OS-generated per-process hash seed** — The HashCode polyfill shared by SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random. Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process; first use adds cryptography initialization overhead. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants while preserving the existing struct-based API, parsing and conversions. Removing the unused deprecated font-face setter import does not remove a public managed member; the assembly version remains 1.0.0.0.

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 introduces HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and 30 additional named Script constants. GPU fixes address reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip capacity and affected ARM Vulkan device-loss cleanup.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing the SkiaSharp managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
